metadata.question: Does cropland area in Brazil increase from 2003 to 2019?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use MODIS MCD12Q1 v6.1 land cover (IGBP scheme) for 2003 and 2019 over Brazil boundary (FAO GAUL; fallback to LSIB if needed). Filter by date within each year.
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking (classification product). Identify cropland as classes 12 (Croplands) and 14 (Cropland/Natural Vegetation Mosaic).
3. Logic: Validate collections (size), valid pixel counts over Brazil, and ensure computed areas are not null. If any year has no images → C1; if zero valid pixels → C2; if area is null/invalid → C3. Otherwise compare 2019 vs 2003 cropland area.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function getInfoAsync(eeObj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => eeObj.getInfo(resolve, reject));
}

async function getBrazilGeometry() {
  // Try FAO GAUL
  try {
    const gaul = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0')
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Brazil'));
    const n = await getInfoAsync(gaul.size());
    if (n > 0) return gaul.geometry();
  } catch (e) {}
  // Fallback: LSIB simple
  try {
    const lsib = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017')
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Brazil'));
    const n2 = await getInfoAsync(lsib.size());
    if (n2 > 0) return lsib.geometry();
  } catch (e) {}
  return null;
}

async function getMCD12ImageForYear(year, region) {
  // Primary attempt: exact year
  let col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD12Q1')
    .filterBounds(region)
    .filterDate(`${year}-01-01`, `${year}-12-31`)
    .select(['LC_Type1']);
  let sz = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
  if (sz === 0) {
    // Widen date window as recovery
    col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD12Q1')
      .filterBounds(region)
      .filterDate(`${year}-01-01`, `${year+1}-12-31`)
      .select(['LC_Type1']);
    sz = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    if (sz === 0) return {image: null, size: 0};
  }
  return {image: col.first(), size: sz};
}

async function computeCroplandStats(img, region) {
  // Total valid pixels in the classification band
  const validCount = await getInfoAsync(
    img.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: 3000,
      maxPixels: 1e13
    }).get('LC_Type1')
  );
  if (validCount === 0) return {validCount: 0, cropAreaKm2: 0};

  const lc = img.select('LC_Type1');
  const croplandMask = lc.eq(12).or(lc.eq(14));
  const areaImg = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1e6).rename('area'); // km²

  const cropArea = await getInfoAsync(
    areaImg.updateMask(croplandMask).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: 3000,
      maxPixels: 1e13
    }).get('area')
  );

  return {validCount: validCount, cropAreaKm2: cropArea};
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry
    const brazil = await getBrazilGeometry();
    if (!brazil) {
      console.log('Brazil geometry not found.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 2. Data acquisition
    const y1 = 2003;
    const y2 = 2019;

    const {image: img2003, size: size2003} = await getMCD12ImageForYear(y1, brazil);
    const {image: img2019, size: size2019} = await getMCD12ImageForYear(y2, brazil);

    console.log(`2003 Images: ${size2003}`);
    console.log(`2019 Images: ${size2019}`);

    if (!img2003 || !img2019) {
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing and validation
    const stats2003 = await computeCroplandStats(img2003, brazil);
    const stats2019 = await computeCroplandStats(img2019, brazil);

    console.log(`2003 Valid Pixels: ${stats2003.validCount}`);
    console.log(`2019 Valid Pixels: ${stats2019.validCount}`);

    if (stats2003.validCount === 0 || stats2019.validCount === 0) {
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    const area2003 = stats2003.cropAreaKm2;
    const area2019 = stats2019.cropAreaKm2;

    if (area2003 === null || area2019 === null || isNaN(area2003) || isNaN(area2019)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`2003 Cropland Area (km²): ${area2003.toFixed(0)}`);
    console.log(`2019 Cropland Area (km²): ${area2019.toFixed(0)}`);
    console.log(`Change (2019 - 2003) km²: ${(area2019 - area2003).toFixed(0)}`);

    // 4. Final answer
    if (area2019 > area2003) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err.message || err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
